mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are clear over Reddan Soccer Park with a temperature of 63 degrees. We are currently under a Waxing Gibbous moon, and tonight we can expect a low of 55 degrees with no rain predicted.

The City of Verona is accepting applications for an Engineering Technician until September 20. Also, please note that sewer and stormwater utility rates were recently adjusted to ensure these self-supporting systems can cover necessary maintenance, equipment, and infrastructure costs.

There is plenty to do this weekend! Today, catch live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company or check out the Girls Try Hockey event. Tomorrow, consider stopping by for yoga at Insight Wellness.

In a report covering the week of August 10 to August 17, officers handled a notable incident on Friday involving a 44-year-old driver who was arrested for an O W I after being found unconscious in her vehicle.
The flavor of the day is Caramel Cashew. Culver's is currently open, but they will be closing in less than 60 minutes, so make sure to head over soon to get your scoop.
